title: Time and tokens per task, in one place

C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Worklog
phases.goal: Tokens and active time for every task, from every session, collected without typing into daily files that common-rules keeps under version control, reviewed each evening.
phases.exit: W-01 to W-04 merged; one full day's worklog committed and its evening page published.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: Fix bin/spend: subagents, once per response, all token kinds
items.what: Read <session>/subagents/*.jsonl too; count each assistant message id once (last record); report input, cache read, cache write and output.
items.done: Tests red first on a fixture with a subagent file and a response written three times.

items.title: bin/worklog collect into common-rules/worklog/<date>.jsonl
items.what: Incremental reader (remembers each transcript's offset); one line per task per session per day with project, session, agent, model, item id (brief tag, then branch, then session), four token kinds, list-price cost and active time (gaps over 5 minutes left out). Numbers and ids only, never transcript text.
items.done: Tests on fixture transcripts for task naming, active time, idempotent re-runs and no text fields.

items.title: Stop hook after each turn and a nightly run with one commit
items.what: derecord installs a Stop hook that runs collect (fast, never fails the session); a nightly scheduled run collects the rest and makes the day's single commit of worklog/ in common-rules. Sessions never commit it.
items.done: Hook test; nightly run commits exactly one file per day.

items.what: bin/worklog day renders the day's page (tasks, sessions, projects, lead vs agents, tokens, cost, active time); the warm card shows yesterday's totals in one line.
